005package org.wpilib.framework;
006
007import org.wpilib.driverstation.internal.DriverStationBackend;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.ControlWord;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DriverStationJNI;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.HAL;
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.RobotMode;
012import org.wpilib.networktables.NetworkTableInstance;
013import org.wpilib.system.Watchdog;
014import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableRegistry;
015import org.wpilib.util.Alert;
016
017/**
018 * IterativeRobotBase implements a specific type of robot program framework, extending the RobotBase
019 * class.
020 *
021 * <p>The IterativeRobotBase class does not implement startCompetition(), so it should not be used
022 * by teams directly.
023 *
024 * <p>This class provides the following functions which are called by the main loop,
025 * startCompetition(), at the appropriate times:
026 *
027 * <p>driverStationConnected() -- provide for initialization the first time the DS is connected
028 *
029 * <p>start() functions -- each of the following functions is called once when the appropriate mode
030 * starts:
031 *
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>disabledStart() -- called each and every time disabled mode starts
034 *   <li>autonomousStart() -- called each and every time autonomous mode starts
035 *   <li>teleopStart() -- called each and every time teleoperated mode starts
036 *   <li>utilityStart() -- called each and every time utility mode starts
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * <p>periodic() functions -- each of these functions is called on an interval:
040 *
041 * <ul>
042 *   <li>robotPeriodic()
043 *   <li>disabledPeriodic()
044 *   <li>enabledPeriodic()
045 *   <li>autonomousPeriodic()
046 *   <li>teleopPeriodic()
047 *   <li>utilityPeriodic()
048 * </ul>
049 *
050 * <p>Order within one loop iteration:
051 *
052 * <ol>
053 *   <li>{@link #driverStationConnected()}, once, the first time the DS is connected
054 *   <li>the end function of the previous mode and the start function of the new mode, only on a
055 *       mode change
056 *   <li>{@link #enabledPeriodic()}, only while enabled
057 *   <li>the periodic function for the current mode ({@link #disabledPeriodic()}, {@link
058 *       #autonomousPeriodic()}, {@link #teleopPeriodic()}, or {@link #utilityPeriodic()})
059 *   <li>{@link #robotPeriodic()}
060 *   <li>{@link #simulationPeriodic()}, only in simulation
061 * </ol>
062 *
063 * <p>The mode-specific periodic function runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()}. Exactly one
064 * mode-specific periodic function runs per iteration.
065 *
066 * <p>end() functions -- each of the following functions is called once when the appropriate mode is
067 * ends:
068 *
069 * <ul>
070 *   <li>disabledEnd() -- called each and every time disabled mode ends
071 *   <li>autonomousEnd() -- called each and every time autonomous mode ends
072 *   <li>teleopEnd() -- called each and every time teleoperated mode ends
073 *   <li>utilityEnd() -- called each and every time utility mode ends
074 * </ul>
075 */
076public abstract class IterativeRobotBase extends RobotBase {
077  private final ControlWord m_word = new ControlWord();
078  private RobotMode m_lastMode;
079  private final double m_period;
080  private final Watchdog m_watchdog;
081  private final Alert m_loopOverrunAlert;
082  private boolean m_calledDsConnected;
083
084  /**
085   * Constructor for IterativeRobotBase.
086   *
087   * @param period Period in seconds.
088   */
089  protected IterativeRobotBase(double period) {
090    m_period = period;
091    m_loopOverrunAlert =
092        new Alert(
093            "iterativerobot-loop-overrun",
094            "Loop time of " + m_period + "s overrun",
095            Alert.Level.MEDIUM);
096    m_watchdog = new Watchdog(period, () -> m_loopOverrunAlert.set(true));
097  }
098
099  /** Provide an alternate "main loop" via startCompetition(). */
100  @Override
101  public abstract void startCompetition();
102
103  /* ----------- Overridable initialization code ----------------- */
104
105  /**
106   * Code that needs to know the DS state should go here.
107   *
108   * <p>Users should override this method for initialization that needs to occur after the DS is
109   * connected, such as needing the alliance information.
110   */
111  public void driverStationConnected() {}
112
113  /**
114   * Robot-wide simulation initialization code should go here.
115   *
116   * <p>Users should override this method for default Robot-wide simulation related initialization
117   * which will be called when the robot is first started. It will be called exactly one time after
118   * the robot class constructor is called only when the robot is in simulation.
119   */
120  public void simulationInit() {}
121
122  /**
123   * Start code for disabled mode should go here.
124   *
125   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time disabled mode
126   * starts.
127   */
128  public void disabledStart() {}
129
130  /**
131   * Start code for autonomous mode should go here.
132   *
133   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time autonomous mode
134   * starts.
135   */
136  public void autonomousStart() {}
137
138  /**
139   * Start code for teleoperated mode should go here.
140   *
141   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time teleoperated mode
142   * starts.
143   */
144  public void teleopStart() {}
145
146  /**
147   * Start code for utility mode should go here.
148   *
149   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time utility mode
150   * starts.
151   */
152  public void utilityStart() {}
153
154  /* ----------- Overridable periodic code ----------------- */
155
156  private boolean m_rpFirstRun = true;
157
158  /**
159   * Periodic code for all robot modes should go here.
160   *
161   * <p>Runs after {@link #enabledPeriodic()} and the current mode's periodic function ({@link
162   * #disabledPeriodic()}, {@link #autonomousPeriodic()}, {@link #teleopPeriodic()}, or {@link
163   * #utilityPeriodic()}), and before {@link #simulationPeriodic()}.
164   */
165  public void robotPeriodic() {
166    if (m_rpFirstRun) {
167      System.out.println("Default robotPeriodic() method... Override me!");
168      m_rpFirstRun = false;
169    }
170  }
171
172  private boolean m_spFirstRun = true;
173
174  /**
175   * Periodic simulation code should go here.
176   *
177   * <p>This function is called in a simulated robot after user code executes. Within a loop
178   * iteration it runs last, after the current mode's periodic function and {@link
179   * #robotPeriodic()}.
180   */
181  public void simulationPeriodic() {
182    if (m_spFirstRun) {
183      System.out.println("Default simulationPeriodic() method... Override me!");
184      m_spFirstRun = false;
185    }
186  }
187
188  private boolean m_dpFirstRun = true;
189
190  /**
191   * Periodic code for disabled mode should go here.
192   *
193   * <p>Runs before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link #simulationPeriodic()}. Never runs in the
194   * same iteration as another mode's periodic function.
195   */
196  public void disabledPeriodic() {
197    if (m_dpFirstRun) {
198      System.out.println("Default disabledPeriodic() method... Override me!");
199      m_dpFirstRun = false;
200    }
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Periodic code for all enabled modes should go here.
205   *
206   * <p>Called once per loop while the robot is enabled, after any mode transition callbacks and
207   * before the current mode's periodic function, {@link #robotPeriodic()}, and {@link
208   * #simulationPeriodic()}. Never runs while disabled.
209   */
210  public void enabledPeriodic() {}
211
212  private boolean m_apFirstRun = true;
213
214  /**
215   * Periodic code for autonomous mode should go here.
216   *
217   * <p>Runs after {@link #enabledPeriodic()} and before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link
218   * #simulationPeriodic()}.
219   */
220  public void autonomousPeriodic() {
221    if (m_apFirstRun) {
222      System.out.println("Default autonomousPeriodic() method... Override me!");
223      m_apFirstRun = false;
224    }
225  }
226
227  private boolean m_tpFirstRun = true;
228
229  /**
230   * Periodic code for teleoperated mode should go here.
231   *
232   * <p>Runs after {@link #enabledPeriodic()} and before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link
233   * #simulationPeriodic()}.
234   */
235  public void teleopPeriodic() {
236    if (m_tpFirstRun) {
237      System.out.println("Default teleopPeriodic() method... Override me!");
238      m_tpFirstRun = false;
239    }
240  }
241
242  private boolean m_tmpFirstRun = true;
243
244  /**
245   * Periodic code for utility mode should go here.
246   *
247   * <p>Runs after {@link #enabledPeriodic()} and before {@link #robotPeriodic()} and {@link
248   * #simulationPeriodic()}.
249   */
250  public void utilityPeriodic() {
251    if (m_tmpFirstRun) {
252      System.out.println("Default utilityPeriodic() method... Override me!");
253      m_tmpFirstRun = false;
254    }
255  }
256
257  /**
258   * End code for disabled mode should go here.
259   *
260   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time disabled mode
261   * ends.
262   */
263  public void disabledEnd() {}
264
265  /**
266   * End code for autonomous mode should go here.
267   *
268   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time autonomous mode
269   * ends.
270   */
271  public void autonomousEnd() {}
272
273  /**
274   * End code for teleoperated mode should go here.
275   *
276   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time teleoperated mode
277   * ends.
278   */
279  public void teleopEnd() {}
280
281  /**
282   * End code for utility mode should go here.
283   *
284   * <p>Users should override this method for code which will be called each time utility mode ends.
285   */
286  public void utilityEnd() {}
287
288  /**
289   * Gets time period between calls to Periodic() functions.
290   *
291   * @return The time period between calls to Periodic() functions.
292   */
293  public double getPeriod() {
294    return m_period;
295  }
296
297  /** Loop function. */
298  protected final void loopFunc() {
299    DriverStationBackend.refreshData();
300    DriverStationBackend.refreshControlWordFromCache(m_word);
301    m_watchdog.reset();
302
303    // Get current mode; treat disabled as unknown
304    boolean enabled = m_word.isEnabled();
305    RobotMode mode = enabled ? m_word.getRobotMode() : RobotMode.UNKNOWN;
306
307    if (!m_calledDsConnected && m_word.isDSAttached()) {
308      m_calledDsConnected = true;
309      driverStationConnected();
310    }
311
312    // If mode changed, call mode end and start functions
313    if (m_lastMode != mode) {
314      if (m_lastMode != null) {
315        // Call last mode's end function
316        switch (m_lastMode) {
317          case UNKNOWN -> disabledEnd();
318          case AUTONOMOUS -> autonomousEnd();
319          case TELEOPERATED -> teleopEnd();
320          case UTILITY -> utilityEnd();
321          default -> {
322            // NOP
323          }
324        }
325      }
326
327      // Call current mode's start function
328      switch (mode) {
329        case UNKNOWN -> {
330          disabledStart();
331          m_watchdog.addEpoch("disabledStart()");
332        }
333        case AUTONOMOUS -> {
334          autonomousStart();
335          m_watchdog.addEpoch("autonomousStart()");
336        }
337        case TELEOPERATED -> {
338          teleopStart();
339          m_watchdog.addEpoch("teleopStart()");
340        }
341        case UTILITY -> {
342          utilityStart();
343          m_watchdog.addEpoch("utilityStart()");
344        }
345        default -> {
346          // NOP
347        }
348      }
349
350      m_lastMode = mode;
351    }
352
353    // Call the appropriate function depending upon the current robot mode
354    DriverStationJNI.observeUserProgram(m_word.getNative());
355    if (enabled) {
356      enabledPeriodic();
357      m_watchdog.addEpoch("enabledPeriodic()");
358    }
359
360    switch (mode) {
361      case UNKNOWN -> {
362        disabledPeriodic();
363        m_watchdog.addEpoch("disabledPeriodic()");
364      }
365      case AUTONOMOUS -> {
366        autonomousPeriodic();
367        m_watchdog.addEpoch("autonomousPeriodic()");
368      }
369      case TELEOPERATED -> {
370        teleopPeriodic();
371        m_watchdog.addEpoch("teleopPeriodic()");
372      }
373      case UTILITY -> {
374        utilityPeriodic();
375        m_watchdog.addEpoch("utilityPeriodic()");
376      }
377      default -> {
378        // NOP
379      }
380    }
381
382    robotPeriodic();
383    m_watchdog.addEpoch("robotPeriodic()");
384
385    TunableRegistry.update();
386    m_watchdog.addEpoch("TunableRegistry.update()");
387
388    if (isSimulation()) {
389      HAL.simPeriodicBefore();
390      simulationPeriodic();
391      HAL.simPeriodicAfter();
392      m_watchdog.addEpoch("simulationPeriodic()");
393    }
394
395    m_watchdog.disable();
396
397    // Flush NetworkTables
398    NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().flushLocal();
399
400    // Warn on loop time overruns, and clear the alert once the loop is back on time
401    if (m_watchdog.isExpired()) {
402      m_watchdog.printEpochs();
403    }
404    m_loopOverrunAlert.set(m_watchdog.isExpired());
405  }
406
407  /** Prints list of epochs added so far and their times. */
408  public void printWatchdogEpochs() {
409    m_watchdog.printEpochs();
410  }
411
412  @Override
413  public void close() {
414    m_loopOverrunAlert.close();
415    super.close();
416  }
417}
